(define (sign n)
  (if (< n 0) 'negative 'non-negative))

(define (classify n)
  (cond ((< n 0) 'negative)
        ((= n 0) 'zero)
        (else    'positive)))

(map classify '(-3 0 7))     ; (negative zero positive)
